policy: All frozen SIMBAD stellar entries within 2000 ly with compiled Johnson V <= 2.41, deduplicating the Alpha Centauri system in favor of A/B components; Acrux uses the Bright Star Catalogue combined V=0.76. Includes Sun as the map origin.

bright-procyon.absoluteMagnitudeMethod: Johnson V and inverse-parallax distance; no extinction correction
bright-procyon.physicalParameters: SIMBAD mesFe_h/mesDiameter ranked measurements, Allende Prieto & Lambert 1999 evolutionary models, McDonald et al. 2012 SED models, and reviewed primary papers; see row notes
bright-procyon.luminosityMethod: McDonald et al. 2012 SED luminosity where available; otherwise Stefan-Boltzmann scaling R^2 (T/5772 K)^4 when both inputs are adopted
